phases.phase_name: Phase 1: Cruise with Partial Ground Visibility in Thin Mist (Slatina -> Bals, 0-30 km)
Phase 2: 0m Whiteout Above Compact Cloud Deck — Zero Ground Lock, Zero GPS (30-80 km)
Phase 3: Sub-Cloud Descent with 6-DoF Turns over Uneven Jiu Valley Terrain (80-98 km)
Phase 4: CAT IIIc 50m Dense Fog Final Approach & SWIR ALS Runway Lock on LRCV RWY 09 (98-100 km)

identified_error_sources.source_name: 1. Unobservable Wind-Shear Drift in Phase 2 (50 km in 0m Cloud Whiteout without ground lock)
identified_error_sources.physical_mechanism: During 720s (50 km) above a compact 0m-MOR cloud deck with w_photon_ground = 0.0, Pitot TAS + PFNd wind memory + E-PG compass hold airspeed and heading, but unobservable altitude wind-shear changes (mean residual ~0.302 m/s) cannot be decoupled from ground speed without optical ground lock.

identified_error_sources.source_name: 2. Baro/RADALT Altitude Scale Error over Uneven Terrain without DEM Map (ev = v * dh / h)
identified_error_sources.physical_mechanism: Translational optical flow measures angular rate (v / h_AGL). Without a pre-loaded Digital Elevation Model (DEM), rolling hills (+/- 6m relief variation over the Jiu Valley) induce small velocity scale residuals ev = v * (dh_relief / h_AGL).

identified_error_sources.source_name: 3. Optical Flow Velocity Integration Random-Walk over 100 km (Dead-Reckoning without Map Landmarks)
identified_error_sources.physical_mechanism: Pure velocity odometry (T4/T5 + LPTC HS/VS) without absolute map landmarks integrates residual zero-mean velocity noise (sigma_v ~ 0.068-0.118 m/s) into a Brownian position random walk proportional to sqrt(t).

identified_error_sources.source_name: 4. 16-Wedge E-PG Ring Attractor Angular Resolution & Residual Gyro Bias in Whiteout
identified_error_sources.physical_mechanism: In the absence of celestial polarization or ground visual landmarks during the 12-minute cloud whiteout, the 16-wedge Ellipsoid Body E-PG ring attractor accumulates a bounded heading drift of ~0.18 deg, inducing a small cross-track velocity projection offset.
identified_error_sources.active_in_phases: Phase 2 (30 km -> 80 km) & Phase 3 (80 km -> 98 km)

engineering_remediation_recommendations: 1. TERCOM / DEM Radar-Altimeter Terrain Matching: Fuse Baro + RADALT profile with an onboard Digital Elevation Model of Oltenia / Jiu Valley to eliminate the 44.7m (14.5%) altitude-scale error and provide intermediate position fixes in Phase 3.

2. Opportunistic Cloud-Hole Ground Glimpse (SWIR 1550nm): Trigger high-gain ES-EKF velocity updates during brief 0.5s breaks in the cloud deck to reset the 217.6m (70.5%) unobservable wind-shear drift in Phase 2.

3. Celestial UV/SWIR Skylight Polarization + 3-Axis Magnetometer into E-PG Ring Attractor: Anchor the 16-wedge Ellipsoid Body compass during above-cloud flight, bounding heading error below 0.02 deg and eliminating the 14.8m (4.8%) angular drift.

4. Linear Feature Waypoint Snap (Jiu River & DN65 Corridor): Use T4/T5 edge orientation to lock cross-track position against known geographic corridors before entering the final CAT IIIc approach cone.
